justification: A table row has no full stop, so the sentence check could not see a dropped table: City of Sydney Schedule 7 Tables S7.1-S7.4 (service bays by GFA, one cell per line) were read as nothing, 19-36% of the numbers on pages 45-47 reached the output. A page with 8+ distinct 3+-digit numbers, under half in the output, is re-read asking for every table row; only provisions bringing a missing number back are kept. Offline on 4 saved reads only those 3 pages crossed the bar.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a dropped table is not found, a copied table is flagged, or a few-number page is judged
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Setting TABLE_NUMBERS_HIT to 0 fails the dropped-table test; restored, all pass.

real_layer_exempt.scripts/ai_extractor.py: offline on saved reads of CoS schedules, KRG 14B, 14F, CoS s2: only schedules p45-47 flagged

pre_impl.existing_data: held chapters' review rows lack the intro/scope sentences printed on the PDF pages
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: page coverage judges a page by most of its rule lines, so an intro paragraph can be lost on a passed page
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: extends the reader after _reread_skipped_pages; reuses page_coverage.running_lines and doubled_text

functions.name: missing_table_numbers
functions.input: page number to page text, and the texts the reader returned
functions.output: page number to the printed numbers the output lacks, for pages whose table was mostly left out
functions.if_none: an empty dict, so no page is re-read for a table

values.read_at: a page is judged when it prints 8+ distinct 3+-digit numbers; flagged under half copied

break_it.scenario: a table copied with its thousands commas removed
break_it.what_happens: it is not flagged as a dropped table

break_it.what_happens: it is not judged as a table
